decision.reason: W7-07 is blocked and current AIP authorities are not atomically joined to a media TaskRun step attempt budget reservation cancellation outcome and final settlement

verifiedFoundations: AIP-7 capacity pool reservation is tenant scoped exact-route model provider bound and prevents pool oversell
AgentRun transition releases an unused capacity reservation on CAS or commit failure
UsageReceipt preserves measured estimated and unknown quality and provider replay is idempotent
UsageAdjustment is append-only and cost attribution keeps unknown separate from hard-budget-eligible measured cost
Provider usage bridge requires a provider receipt and forwards to canonical Usage authority
focused capacity transition usage attribution and provider bridge tests are GREEN
blockers: W7-07 is not GREEN and no media Provider attempt can produce authoritative capacity usage cancel or receipt facts
capacity reservation is keyed to AgentRun rather than TaskRun stepKey attempt and media adapter request fingerprint
capacity pool models concurrency and token units only; no reviewed GPU render TTS storage bandwidth or live-session dimensions exist
no budget reservation authority binds projected cost currency profile Stage count retry allowance ProviderPrice and approval
capacity reserve consume release and Stage lease or Provider submit are not one durable state transition
a consumed capacity reservation cannot be released by the current terminal API and remains active until expiry without settlement semantics
UsageReceipt is not atomically bound to media Artifact Stage attempt Provider request Capacity reservation or budget reservation
no settlement authority converts estimated or unknown usage to measured adjusted refunded disputed or written-off outcomes
multi-currency projected and actual amounts have no explicit no-conversion bucket reconciliation contract
cancel only expresses local intent unless the adapter proves provider cancellation; it cannot claim fee reversal or capacity release
late Provider receipts after cancel timeout or takeover have no ordering reducer against attempt fence and settlement state
partial Artifact and partial Usage allocation across successful failed cancelled and invalidated Stages is undefined
unknown usage is not reserved as configurable budget exposure until reconciliation matures
no final cost variance decision explains projection versus measured estimated unknown adjustments refunds and taxes
no Media Studio cost timeline or org-org positive and dev-org isolation evidence exists

targetBoundary.capacity: reservation exact scope is TaskRun stepKey attempt request fingerprint and versioned multidimensional pool; it remains separate from budget
targetBoundary.budget: immutable BudgetReservation binds confirmed projected range currency bucket retry reserve policy approval and exact price refs before a chargeable submit
targetBoundary.usage: every provider receipt appends measured estimated or unknown Usage against exact Stage attempt Artifact provider request capacity and budget refs
targetBoundary.cancel: cancel records intent and adapter outcome separately; only trusted provider evidence can prove stopped work and no fee
targetBoundary.settlement: append-only SettlementDecision and UsageAdjustment mature unknown or estimated facts without overwriting original receipts
targetBoundary.unknown: unknown usage counts toward configurable exposure and is never removed from dashboards or success denominators
targetBoundary.final: final variance is grouped by currency and separates projection measured estimated unknown adjustment refund tax and residual dispute

tests.meaning: separate generic capacity usage attribution and provider bridge foundations are stable; no test proves their media-stage atomic join cancellation or settlement
